explanation: The sleep environment contains multiple loose blankets both over and around the infant, including one bunched up near the baby's feet and another under the baby's lower body. There is also an additional soft, possibly padded item with a polka-dot pattern under the baby's head. Furthermore, soft, padded inserts or bumpers are visible along the sides of the sleep space. All these items (loose blankets, extra soft bedding, bumpers) are considered serious suffocation and entrapment hazards for infants and are contrary to safe sleep guidelines.
